description:
Wire snow_connector.py (built 2026-04-16) into the approval_workflow daemon. This is the Phase 9 ServiceNow inbound integration.

MUST: Use write_service at :8772 for state exchange, never HTTP between peer daemons.
MUST: Query mcp_server_registry for pending submissions via POST :8772/query.
MUST: Insert ServiceNow ticket references into mcp_submissions table with correct columns (mcp_name, requested_by).
MUST: Authenticate via SNOW OAuth credentials from os.environ; never hardcode tokens.
MUST: Validate request signatures before processing any webhook payload.
MUST NOT: Accept unsigned webhooks under any circumstance.
MUST NOT: Write directly to DuckDB; all writes via write_service.
Phase 9 enterprise integration per ZO-SENTINEL Product Specification section 1.
